content.value: Suppose a real-estate company wants to develop a new town close to Zero (10) Point, Khulna. Identify the major actors involved in the whole process. If governance is a process, explain the negotiation process of the land and housing development. Do you think that such negotiation will bring the bestplanned development? If ‘yes', How? if ‘no', wny?
